findings.finding: All three primary TOP3 lists rank the same two stationary source channels first and second.
findings.interpretation: The tiny drift is numerical grid representation of effectively zero physical drift. These are two common spectral components, not six independent newly discovered sources.

findings.finding: Both stationary components have large robust box-track responses in all six historical scans.
findings.interpretation: Multi-direction recurrence is consistent with a common contribution such as terrestrial or instrumental contamination; physical origin is not established. There is no direction-exclusive SETI detection and no independent repeat of an OFF primary.

findings.finding: The stationary primaries receive positive contributions from all 16 rows. Largest single positive primary-row share is roughly 6.4–6.6%.
findings.interpretation: They are persistent across each primary scan rather than supported by a single isolated integration. Persistence alone does not establish celestial origin.

findings.finding: Each rank3 drifting box overlaps the first stationary component during its final eight primary rows, which supply more than 99.976% of its positive box contribution.

findings.interpretation: The earlier component was not used to explain these different frequencies.

editorial_additions: Publish the separate concise Danish PROJECT_STATUS addition to state the two common-frequency findings explicitly; the immutable automatic report already shows them correctly in tables and figures.
Use six scans across four target directions when describing recurrence.
Reference-channel counts are carrier maximum records across three primaries, not 6.29 million distinct sky frequencies.
scientific_limits: One historical 2017 observation per OFF-primary star; context scans do not constitute independent target replication.
Robust box-track scores are uncalibrated; no global FAP, flux sensitivity, source-origin classification or detection claim is made.
Independent QA validates source bits, selected arithmetic and ranking; it does not exhaustively recompute the detector grid or independently refilter fullcore MAD/location.
